target: Where there is a will, there is a way
note: Methali hii ina mshabaha kamili na ya Kiswahili.
Maana yake ni ile ile — kufanya haraka huharibu kazi.

target: Slow and steady wins the race
note: Inatoka katika hadithi ya kobe na sungura.
Hakuna njia ya mkato — ni kurudia tu.

target: Two heads are better than one
source: Vichwa viwili ni bora kuliko kimoja
note: Linganisha na: kidole kimoja hakivunji chawa.
Husemwa mtu anapoomba radhi kwa kuchelewa.

target: Rome was not built in a day
The early bird catches the worm
Every cloud has a silver lining
source: Kila jambo baya lina jema lake
note: Hata katika shida kuna jambo jema.

target: A stitch in time saves nine
note: Methali ya Kiswahili inayolingana nayo kabisa.

target: After the storm comes the calm
note: Husemwa kumfariji mtu aliye katika shida.

target: Do not count your chickens before they hatch
When in Rome, do as the Romans do
source: Ukienda kwa Warumi, fanya kama Warumi
